incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: P125 on service="inference-runtime" region=eu-west — alert group=latency/route. Auto-escalation in 2m if unacked. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incident/P125 (bot)
ajay: acked. I'm on it. Seeing a short tail-latency spike on router-proxy in eu-west, ~20-40s. spinning up triage.
maria: thanks. pinging infra team to check autoscaler behavior. any signs of customer impact yet?
leo: quick look at logs — small burst of 503s from synthetic-canary job "canary-job-3". ~12 failures over 2m window. real-customer 5xx does not show a concurrent rise.
ajay: running `kubectl -n inference get hpa router-proxy -o wide` shows desired replicas flip: desired=5 -> desired=1 within ~90s. Might be HPA instability causing warm containers to drop requests. snippet:
```
HPA router-proxy: current=3, desired=5 -> current=2 -> desired=1 (90s)
```
sre-oncall: PD shows repeated quick-fires, looks like a flapping pattern. I'm going to apply a temporary silence for 10m to suppress noise while we triage, will leave escalation channel open.
deploy-bot: Deploy #2431 to router-proxy (eu-west) finished ~30m ago; no immediate rollback recorded.
maria: can someone confirm telemetry — latency percentiles for real traffic? cc @customer-success if any visible degradation.
leo: metric query result: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod", job="router-proxy"}[2m])) by (code)` — no sustained elevation in 5xx outside canary windows. p95/p99 stable. conclusion: customer-facing impact = none.
ajay: marking as no-customer-impact. PD incident will auto-resolve in a few minutes unless it re-trips. provisional cause: HPA oscillation + cold-container churn exposed by sensitive synthetic canary.
maria: please add a brief note to the incident backlog: "flapping HPA + canary sensitivity". action item: increase HPA stabilization window and tweak canary retry/backoff.
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved by system after 9m of flapping. PagerDuty incident closed. If recurrence occurs, new PD incident will be created and this thread can be referenced.
ajay: thanks everyone. I'll follow up in #eng-runtime with a small runbook snippet and HPA proposal. :white_check_mark:
